title: External Review Terms by Northbridge Appeals Package
content:
Under the Member Appeals Program, external review means review of a final internal denial by a reviewer outside the internal appeal process. The terms of external review are set by the member's Northbridge Appeals package.

Column key: (1) Level One Delegated, (2) Two-Level Delegated, (3) Single-Level with External Review, (4) Two-Level with External Review, (5) State-Regulated Insured, (6) Full Fiduciary Delegation. Each number is the Northbridge Appeals package of that name.

| Term | (1) | (2) | (3) | (4) | (5) | (6) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A final internal denial may go to external review | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Route | None | None | Federal | Federal | State | Federal |
| Months after the final internal denial notice to request it | 0 | 0 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 |
| Standard review decided within (calendar days from the reviewer's receipt) | 0 | 0 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 |
| Expedited review decided within (hours) | 0 | 0 | 72 | 72 | 72 | 72 |
| Fee charged to the member to file (USD) | $0 | $0 | $0 | $0 | $25 | $0 |
| Denials eligible | Medical judgment | Medical judgment | Medical judgment | Medical judgment | All adverse | All adverse |
| An urgent case may go to expedited external review while the urgent internal appeal is pending | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Member may go straight to external review when the plan does not follow the claims procedure | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| The external reviewer's overturn binds the plan | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Definitions used in the table

- **Federal**: an independent review organization under the federal process.
- **State**: the state insurance department's process.
- **None**: the package offers no external review route. In the time columns, 0 means external review is not available under that package.
- **Medical judgment**: denials based on medical necessity, appropriateness, or experimental status.
- **All adverse**: every adverse decision.
- **Fee**: any fee charged is refunded when the denial is overturned.

## Reading across the packages

- Northbridge Appeals Level One Delegated and Northbridge Appeals Two-Level Delegated offer no external review.
- Northbridge Appeals State-Regulated Insured is the only package that uses the state route, and the only package that charges a fee ($25, refunded on overturn).
- Northbridge Appeals State-Regulated Insured and Northbridge Appeals Full Fiduciary Delegation accept every adverse decision for external review. Northbridge Appeals Single-Level with External Review and Northbridge Appeals Two-Level with External Review accept only medical-judgment denials.
- *Hypothetical example.* A member under Northbridge Appeals Two-Level with External Review has a final internal denial based on medical necessity, and the review is expedited. That denial falls within scope, and the expedited review is decided within 72 hours.
